create_mock_agent_state: create a MockAgentState instance to manage in-memory agent state for testing
set_init_state: set the initial state data on a MockAgentState instance using _set_init_state
get_init_state: get the initial state dict from a MockAgentState instance using get_init_state
get_data: get the full agent state dict with inputs and outputs using get_data
update_data: update the live state of a MockAgentState instance with new data using update_data
